historical_references.reference: The Evanshis were a clan of the Vedic tribes, mentioned in the Rigveda as one of the seven tribes associated with the god Rudra. They are described as 'the Evanshis, the Rudra-yajna-performers'.

The Evanshi are also mentioned in the Mahabharata as the descendants of King Ikshvaku's son, Anari-Partha. According to the epic, the Evanshi rulers included King Sahasranga, who had 1001 sons, and King Prthu Savan, who was a great warrior and ruled over a vast kingdom.
